title: THE LORD IS MY STRENGTH
PSALM 28:7 PRAYER
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving

scenes.a: If you are facing an anxious decision right now, let your weary heart be still.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped:
therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
scenes.sub: WITH MY SONG WILL I PRAISE HIM

scenes.a: We give You thanks, O Lord, for being our constant protector, our shield, and our unfailing support.
In every trial, You guard our steps and gently quiet our fears. We praise You today for every silent mercy and grace.
Our hearts overflow with joy in Your holy presence. Subscribe to The Praise Garden as we enter His gates with thanksgiving.
